Title: AI Engineer

Support the deployment of AI models into production, run simulations for algorithm development, and collaborate onthe design of intelligent systems. Develop and integrate RESTful APIs to connect various systems and services within the ML platform. Help automate AI model training, re-training, and deployment pipelines by applying Agile methodologies and CI/CD/CT principles, under the guidance of senior engineers. Experiment with emerging technologies (NLP, Computer Vision, MLOps, Kubernetes) to continuously grow your own technical expertise and share new learnings with the team. Participate in innovating and standardizing AI/ML development practices within the team. Effectively leverage AI-powered development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cline, or Open Code) to accelerate software delivery while rigorously maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and performance. A solid foundational understanding of Machine Learning concepts and Generative AI (GenAI) technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs). Experience with AI/ML workflow orchestration tools: e.g., Airflow, Kubeflow etc. Experience in DevSecOps using tools such as Tekton, SonarQube, Checkmarks etc. Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Bash, PowerShell). Desired Skills Masters in computer science / AI, Machine Learning or related field. Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools like GitHub Actions, SonarQube, or Checkmarks. Basic knowledge or experience with Terraform. Title: Quality Coordinator - Power BI
Industries: Professional Services, Manufacturing, and Technology, Information and Media
Description: Job Description This position will focus on supporting the Retail & Consumer Products Quality team through the collection, cleansing, integration, and analysis of quality data. The role will be responsible for identifying data-driven improvement opportunities, developing complex dashboards, supporting special projects, and collaborating with Quality leadership to drive strategic decisions based on insights. The position will also contribute to the creation and maintenance of data products, reports, and analytical solutions for the department. This is a hybrid position, requiring 3 days per week onsite at the Mexico City office. Responsibilities Collect, clean, integrate, and analyze data from multiple sources for incorporation into complex dashboards. Evaluate, interpret, and analyze data to generate conclusions and action recommendations. Develop, update, and maintain advanced reports and dashboards in Power BI. Prepare and present reports with clear recommendations and evidence-based arguments. Collaborate with Quality leadership to identify improvement opportunities based on data analysis. Identify improvement opportunities, key metrics, and corrective actions when performance is not progressing as expected. Support the development, definition, and implementation of analytical and reporting products and services for the Quality department. Maintain data catalogs and ensure the availability of key data sources for internal and external stakeholders. Train internal clients on department applications, analytical products, or reports when necessary. Actively participate in continuous improvement activities to strengthen departmental operations and overall quality. Support the implementation of new processes related to data, analytics, or quality. Comply with the Underwriters Laboratories Code of Conduct and physical and digital security practices. Perform other duties assigned by management. Qualifications Required Qualifications Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power BI. Experience in data management, integration, cleansing, and analysis. Ability to organize, correlate, and interpret information to generate insights. Experience developing complex dashboards and analytical reports in Power BI. Advanced English proficiency. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Typically 4+ years of experience in quality-related roles. Experience investigating and resolving data issues identified through dashboards. Proven ability to identify project needs, define objectives, and independently plan and execute initiatives. Knowledge of Quality processes, procedures, and objectives. Proficiency with computer equipment and Microsoft applications (Word, Excel). About Us A global leader in applied safety science, UL Solutions (NYSE: ULS) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. UL Solutions delivers testing, inspection and certification services, together with software products and advisory offerings, that support our customers’ product innovation and business growth. The UL Mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. We help our customers innovate, launch new products and services, navigate global markets and complex supply chains, and grow sustainably and responsibly into the future. Our science is your advantage. About The Team From life jackets to lawnmowers, toys to televisions, beauty and wellness, vitamins and supplements, we’re involved in almost every consumer product you can imagine. We work with some of the largest retailers in the world, performing market surveillance, auditing and inspecting the products we put in and on our bodies. We help customers ensure that not only are their products themselves safe, but their supply chains are using ethically and sustainably sourced materials. We build close relationships, providing advice and expertise to help them deliver safer products that meet the latest requirements and manufacture them fairly. Join our team and make your mark on products that shape people’s lives.
